Has a range of 20 and tick of 0.1. |ability1_cooldown = 10 }} ==Description== The '''Projector''' was an enemy that appeared in [[The Narratorium]] as a part of [[The Final Act Event]]. It had a high amount of health and a slightly slow speed. It can stun towers for 2.5 seconds and deal 700 damage to units by flashing them with the light on its projector head. This ability has a range of 15 and tick of 0.1. ==Logbook Description== "''The Projector Man is a stark reminder of the Narrator's twisted mind. It is used to display movies for entertainment or project screens for plays. The Projector Man was once a whole person but was reconstructed to serve the Narrator's purposes. When alone, it finds a quiet corner and projects memories of it's past life, reminiscing about happier times.''" ==Appearance== The '''Projector''' is a tall hobject-headed robot which has a projector for a head. It wears a red shirt, blue pants and black shoes. Using its projector head, it will shoot its laser ray light to towers near it. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *While slow, '''Projectors''' are very tanky, especially when [[Bloated]]. High damage towers are a necessity by their debut, and only become more of a necessity due to '''Projectors''' being both [[Stun Immunity|Stun]] and [[Freeze Immunity|Freeze Immune]]. ** If one happens to own it, [[Toxic Gunner]] can slow them down quite a lot, giving you much more free room to deal with them. *'''Projectors''' can quickly stun groups of towers through their ''Tachyon Light'' ability, also quickly damaging any units caught in the crossfire. **Distracting them with less valuable towers at the entrance can not only buy some time, but also keep your stronger towers safe. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} ProjectorWalk.gif|Walking animation (20 December 2025 – Present) ProjectorAttack.gif|''Tachyon Light'' animation (20 December 2025 – Present) ProjectorDeath.gif|Death animation (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseProjector.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ProjectorIconIG.png|'''Projector''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *Strangely, the '''Projector''' is referred to as "''Projector Man''" in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]] entry. **This may be an earlier name for it, before being shortened to just "'''''Projector'''''". *The '''Projector''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]]a **'''Projector''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Projector's''' head does not move in the [[Index]]. **{{Bug}} '''Projector's''' animations overlap its death animation. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **'''Projector''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{TheNarratorium|[[Producer]]|Wave 25|Projector|Wave 26|[[Painter]]|Wave 28}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
